relations.name: assistant_analytics_orders
relations.purpose: Authorized service orders with assignment, branch, scheduling, quotation, and lifecycle details.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.meaning: Name of the customer requesting service.

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: Exact lifecycle state of the service order.

columns.name: quoted_price
columns.meaning: Initial service quotation before extra charges.

columns.name: assigned_technician_id
columns.meaning: Internal identity of the assigned technician.

columns.name: technician_name
columns.meaning: Display name of the assigned technician.

columns.name: branch_name
columns.meaning: Operational branch responsible for the order.

columns.name: scheduled_at
columns.timestamp_semantics: Use for scheduled workload and today/tomorrow task questions.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Time the order was last changed.
columns.timestamp_semantics: Use only when lifecycle transition time has no dedicated relation.

relations.name: assistant_analytics_completions
relations.purpose: Authorized field-service completion values and completion timestamps.
relations.grain: Zero or one completion row per service order.

columns.name: order_id
columns.meaning: Service order completed by this record.

columns.name: technician_id
columns.meaning: Internal identity of technician completing work.

columns.name: technician_name
columns.meaning: Display name of technician completing work.

columns.name: final_amount
columns.meaning: Final service value equal to quote plus extra charges.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.meaning: Time field service was marked done.
columns.timestamp_semantics: Use for completed-work and service-value periods.

relations.name: assistant_analytics_payments
relations.purpose: Authorized customer payment transactions recorded against service orders.
relations.grain: One row per customer payment transaction.

columns.name: amount
columns.meaning: Amount received in this payment transaction.

columns.name: method
columns.meaning: Payment method used by the customer.

relations.name: assistant_analytics_schedule_events
relations.purpose: Authorized schedule-change history including reasons and previous/new visit times.

columns.name: previous_scheduled_at
columns.meaning: Visit time before this schedule change.

columns.name: new_scheduled_at
columns.meaning: Visit time after this schedule change.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Time the schedule event was recorded.

relations.name: assistant_analytics_reviews
relations.purpose: Authorized manager review outcomes for completed service work.
relations.grain: One row per manager review attempt.

columns.name: reviewed_at
columns.meaning: Time the manager recorded the review.
columns.timestamp_semantics: Use for review and correction periods.

relations.name: assistant_analytics_checklist
relations.purpose: Authorized required and optional checklist completion state for service orders.
relations.grain: One row per order checklist item.

columns.name: order_id
columns.meaning: Service order owning this checklist item.

columns.name: required
columns.meaning: Whether completion is mandatory before job completion.

columns.name: completed
columns.meaning: Whether the technician completed the item.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.meaning: Time the item was completed, null while incomplete.

joins.meaning: Connect an order to its optional completion.
Connect an order to all customer payments.
Connect an order to schedule changes.
Connect an order to manager reviews.
Connect an order to checklist items.
Connect final service value to payment transactions by order.
